gates.publicRelocationCoverage: Passed 30 of 30 with the exact selected area and a position near its destination.
gates.worldOwnedEndpointByteStability: Passed: each area repeats an identical active-byte estimate and tile count 10 times.
gates.reservationAndCoverageLeaseRelease: Passed: pending, staged, retiring and skyline lifecycle counters, coverageLeaseCount and relocationReserveBytes are zero at all 30 endpoints.
gates.boundedPoolAndBoardCache: Observed within configured bounds: the idle vehicle pool reaches 96; maximum boardBytes 24387328 is below 24 MiB (25165824). The board cache still warms.
gates.decodedWorkerEstimate: Observed maximum 87596096 bytes is below 96 MiB (100663296). Decoded entry count is absent from these snapshots.
gates.fullRendererResourcePlateau: Not established: geometry and texture counts still trend upward as vehicle and board caches warm. Last-five texture range reaches 5.714 percent at Gachibowli and Uppal.
gates.postWarmupTenStableLoops: Not established: these 10 loops include initial cache warming; they are not 10 loops after all resources have warmed.
gates.postGCHeapPlateau: Not measured: no forced GC or equal-state post-GC capture. The peak of 1168467741 bytes and later Uppal sample of 338928765 show a collection sawtooth, not retained-memory proof.
gates.strictForegroundJobBudget: Not established by endpoint snapshots. Installation and activation maxima retain isolated overruns; inspect raw frame histories separately.

findings: All 30 public area selections succeeded after the coverage lease change. Selected area, position, coins, delivery total and orders OFF were consistent.

World-owned endpoint active bytes are exactly 138748476 at RTC X Roads, 110547340 at Gachibowli and 127414024 at Uppal. Pending, retiring, staged, lease and reserve counters are zero at all endpoints.

RTC renderer geometries increase 869 -> 998 and textures 26 -> 73; Gachibowli 1137 -> 1239 and 36 -> 74; Uppal 1055 -> 1144 and 41 -> 74. These growing resource counts do not establish a full GPU plateau.

Last-five geometry ranges are below 1 percent. Last-five texture range is 4.286 percent at RTC and 5.714 percent at Gachibowli and Uppal. A small range with a positive retention trend does not automatically pass the plan.
Bus-board caches grow toward 24 MiB and the vehicle pool reaches 96. Finite bounded warming is plausible, but this dataset alone does not prove all zero-reference GPU resources are released.
Heap observations span 270904165 to 1168467741 bytes. No post-GC leak verdict or physical-phone memory claim is made.

The earlier pre-lease area-cycles-06 timeout and Uppal placement failure are retained. Successful retry and the synthetic eviction-gap reproduction support the correction; the exact original runtime cause remains provisional.

finalPostGcAreaCycles.method: 20 public area-selection loops through RTC X Roads, Gachibowli and Uppal; first 10 warm-up, next 10 post-warm. Pause and explicit CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage at each settled endpoint; 4.04x desktop CPU throttle, Android emulator stopped. Not gameplay duration, foreground phone cost or FPS evidence.
finalPostGcAreaCycles.verdict: Post-warm JS heap, backing storage and renderer geometry count ranges are below 5% at each repeated endpoint; the texture count gate is NOT passed (6.33-7.59% ranges). All 60 endpoint samples have zero staged/retiring/reserved/lease/admission state, exact per-area active tile bytes and bounded cache counters. This is lifecycle/residency evidence, not certification of actual GPU VRAM plateau or leak freedom. Texture cache warm-up/ownership still needs longer or category-level analysis.
limitations: Explicit GC changes workload and must not be used as frame-time or phone foreground-cost evidence. The cumulative install/activation maximum22.1ms occurred in this 4.04x+explicit-GC diagnostic.
Last people cache has28 entries,4 unused (3,349,632 estimated bytes),created28,disposed0: runtime did not trigger the420-variant unit-test eviction path; unit disposal tests remain separate evidence.
Skyline30,280,800bytes persists as a bounded visual cache; zero liveness counters do not mean zero caches or exact GPU VRAM accounting.
